description: Bulk move issues to another queue. Components, versions and projects are cleared by default.

confirm.description: Set to true to confirm this destructive/bulk operation

issues.description: List of issue keys/ids OR a Tracker query-language filter string, e.g. "Queue: TREK Assignee: user1" (max 10000 issues per operation)

notify.description: Notify users about the change (default false)

name: bulk_move_issues
